h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Unnao

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Unnao

c: Unnao sits on the highway between Kanpur and Lucknow, with tanneries, food processing units and other industries along the road. Many of our enquiries from towns like this come from factory managements, schools and municipal bodies that want a working open gym on a modest budget. FunPlay Systems is an outdoor gym equipment supplier in Unnao, manufacturing at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, about 1,110 km away.

Central Uttar Pradesh has very hot summers, a humid monsoon and cold, foggy winters. Our Fun Fitness machines are galvanised pipe with roto-moulded parts, made for all three seasons outdoors. We send them by road and install with our team or a dealer in north India, after you approve a layout drawing that shows every machine and its clear space.

items.q: Where should a factory place its outdoor gym?
items.a: Near the canteen or rest area, away from vehicle routes and loading bays. A paved, well-lit base makes it usable before and after every shift.

items.q: Can the machines handle cold, foggy winters?
items.a: Yes. The frames are galvanised and the seats and handles are roto-moulded, so moisture from fog does not cause rust. Wipe them down in the mornings.

items.q: Can you work to a fixed budget?
items.a: Yes. Tell us the budget and the space, and we will suggest a set of machines, often including combination frames that give more exercises for each foundation.
